about_short_description.short_description: Kabilah is simplifying patient handoff for inpatient nurses.

product.name: Kabilah Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform designed to support inpatient nursing workflows by automating verbal handoffs, generating digital report sheets, managing tasks, and integrating with EHRs to reduce documentation burden.

product.name: Consistent & Complete Verbal Handoff Solution
product.description: A proprietary system within the Kabilah Platform that ensures thorough and accurate verbal handoffs by alerting nurses to missing critical information and correcting inaccuracies during patient transitions.

product.name: Digital Report Sheets
product.description: A digital replacement for traditional paper report sheets that consolidates patient information in a clean, accessible format to save time and reduce errors during nursing shifts.

product.name: Guided Task Management
product.description: An AI-driven task management tool that generates context-aware ToDo lists prioritizing urgent nursing tasks to streamline workflows and enhance patient safety.

identifier.value: EHR Integration for Charting and Flowsheet Completion

product.name: EHR Integration for Charting and Flowsheet Completion
product.description: A feature that integrates with hospital EHR systems to export report sheets into various note types and flowsheets, reducing redundant documentation for nurses.
